structured_output.summary: Pass: ready to merge. Pickup state (armed, boostTicks) is now per car. Collection runs in car-index order, so the lower index wins ties. Each car fires on its own action. stepCars takes a per-car boost array, and with three arguments no car boosts. Stale comments are fixed. AI bots (car 1+) fire only when armed, on dirt, grounded, with ~48 units plus braking from 32 clear of slow corners and ramps (plus a 4-unit margin). While boosting they aim for the corner limit, capped at 32, and brake as before. Car 0's bot never fires. The optional nudge toward boxes was not built (the spec says 'may'). No UI change; screenshots look unchanged. New tests cover AC1–AC8 through public seams and would fail on main. AC3 and AC4 use the plan audit's tighter wording. All gates green: 821/821 tests, Dust Bowl bot lap 2.3% faster, replays unchanged. No sniffing, no duplicated work. Unchecked: whether game or render code reads world.pickups.armed directly as a boolean. Low risk: typecheck passes and the armed HUD screenshot looks right.
